schema.name: uuid_track
schema.comment: unique identifier of this track segment

schema.name: src_id
schema.comment: optional source-system identifier for the segment

schema.name: src_id_node_from
schema.comment: optional source-system identifier of the first node

schema.name: src_id_node_to
schema.comment: optional source-system identifier of the last node

schema.name: geometry
schema.comment: track geometry (expected to be a LineString)

schema.name: reversed
schema.comment: true when this segment was generated in reverse orientation

schema.name: level
schema.comment: optional vertical level (e.g. tunnel/bridge stacking level)

schema.name: properties
schema.comment: additional source attributes as key-value pairs
